sections.title: What's New
items: Daylight Mirror: show your Mac or PC screen on your DC-1, over USB-C or Wi-Fi.
A new Software Update app. It tells you when an update is ready and installs it with one tap.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Kindle is updated to version 8.157. Your books and sign-in carry over.
Scrolling with a finger while mirroring a Mac keeps going smoothly instead of stopping.
The update popups have a cleaner design with clearer buttons, and Software Update now has a Release Notes link.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: The version number on the Software Update screen is no longer cut off.
